architecture:
## Android data-plane architecture (Services / State non-playback)

### 0. Decisions made in this area
1. **Profile sync without CloudKit = port `CloudSyncService` verbatim over a `CloudDocDatabase` interface, backed by S3 through a tiny first-party Lambda (`pocketdj-profile-sync`).** The iOS engine (`CloudSyncService.swift`) is already pure over `CloudDocDatabase` (accountAvailable / fetchMeta / fetch / save / delete / deleteAll) and is unit-tested against an in-memory DB; porting the engine unchanged preserves every hard-won rule (2 s skew, `.pre-cloud` backup, watermark semantics, merge-on-reload clears watermark, meta-probed pushDirty, onboarding push gate, 8 s launch deadline). Only the backend differs:
   - Objects: `profiles/<profileId>/<key>.json` in a private bucket (same account as `diagLogsBase`), S3 user-metadata `x-amz-meta-modified-at-ms`, `x-amz-meta-device`. `fetchMeta` = one Lambda call returning `{key: modifiedAtMs}` (HEAD fan-out server-side).
   - HTTP API (new remote-endpoint key `profileSyncBase`, OPTIONAL in the v1 doc — absent ⇒ sync disabled, never derived from another key): `POST /enroll` (header `X-PocketDJ-Enroll` = shipped capability token, same pattern as `Config.recEngineEnrollSecret`; body `{profileId, secretHash}`), then `GET /meta?keys=`, `GET /doc/{key}`, `PUT /doc/{key}` (headers `X-PocketDJ-Modified-At`, `X-PocketDJ-Device`), `DELETE /doc/{key}`, `DELETE /profile` — all with `Authorization: Bearer <profileSecret>` + `X-PocketDJ-Profile`.
   - Identity: `profileId` = the durable UUID in `pocketdj-profile.json`; `profileSecret` = 32 random bytes minted on device at enroll, stored in **EncryptedSharedPreferences** (Android Keystore master key), never in DataStore/JSON. "Link with iCloud" becomes **"Link a device"**: the enrolled device shows a QR (zxing, already a dependency) / 20-char code encoding `pocketdj://link?p=<profileId>&s=<secret>`; the new device types/scans it, probes the cloud profile (`probeCloudProfile`) and runs `restoreForOnboarding`. `accountAvailable()` ⇔ a secret is present AND the last `/meta` probe was not 401/403.
   - Why not CloudKit JS / Firebase / direct SigV4: CloudKit web needs an Apple ID web flow and a public container; a per-user IAM key is unacceptable; Firebase adds a second cloud. The Lambda+S3 shape is what `am-playlist-sync` and `rec-engine` already use and what ARCHITECTURE-ANDROID.md sketched ("per-profile documents under an authenticated prefix").
   - The Lambda is **outside android/** (`scripts/lambda/profile-sync/`), ~400 lines Node, listed as package SYNC-0; the Android engine ships first against an in-memory DB and a MockWebServer so Sonnet packages are independently testable.
2. **Burns live app-private** (`filesDir/burns/`, ledger `filesDir/pocketdj-burns.json`) in v1. A user-browsable folder (SAF `ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT_TREE` + persisted tree URI, `DocumentFile`) is a P2 package: it is the Android twin of the security-scoped bookmark and must obey the same rule — the destination is captured onto the transfer record at enqueue time, never read from live settings inside the worker.
3. **TransferCoordinator = WorkManager.** `OneTimeWorkRequest` per song (`enqueueUniqueWork("burn:<songId>", KEEP)`), a `CoroutineWorker` that streams OkHttp → `<audio>.part` → atomic rename, runs as a **foreground (long-running) worker** with a progress notification (plain progress on API 35; `Notification.ProgressStyle` on 36 — the listed API-36 candidate). Records persist in `pocketdj-transfers.json` (iOS shape + additive `workId`). WorkManager gives survival across process death and cold relaunch; `reconcileOnLaunch` = cross-check records vs `WorkManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWork`. `DownloadManager` was rejected (cannot target app-private `filesDir`; no header control guarantees).
4. **Mix DSP engine: not touched by this area.** Burn/stem file naming (`stem-<id>-<part>.mp3`, `analysis-<id>.json`, descriptive `<prefix>-<id>.mp3`) is the only contract the Mix area consumes; it is fixed here.
5. **Secrets move to EncryptedSharedPreferences** (rip token, jukebox token, Music-User-Token, profile secret, diag key); non-secret settings stay in the Preferences DataStore. Migration is additive: read DataStore value once, copy, blank the DataStore key.
6. **Diag channel gate** = `BuildConfig.DEBUG || BuildConfig.DIAG_CHANNEL` (a `buildConfigField` set true for an `internal` build flavour; release = false). No App-Store-receipt analogue exists.
7. **Compiled-in endpoints flip to green** (623170744161) with a JVM test pinning `EndpointConfig.COMPILED_IN` to `config/endpoints.green.json` (blue was deleted 2026-10-15 per memory; a compiled-in blue only matters when `app.pocket-dj.com` is unreachable on first launch, but then it is fatal).

### 2. Data flow
- **Play ▶ (data-plane part):** `PlayResolver.resolve(songId)` rung 0 = `BurnStore.localUrlForPlayback(songId)` (burned-first, EVERY song-start path; analog shared file + `startMs` clip) → rung 1 manifest hit → `PresignCache.prefetched(songId) ?: ripServer.presign(songId)` (direct URL only when no server) → AM rungs (streaming area) → rung 4 `RipRequired`: `requestRip` + 20 s bounded wait → `StillRipping` outcome + `RipJobTracker.pollToReady` (2 s, ≤1 h, never stops on error) → `onRipReady` refreshes manifest and lets the row flip. `PlaybackMode.DEVICE` skips un-burned tracks and raises the one-shot `deviceQueueUnplayable` banner when the whole queue is un-burned (ARCHITECTURE-APPLE item 23).
- **Setlist prefetch:** the setlist transport (playback area) calls `PresignCache.prefetch(nextIds)` and `RipServerClient.requestRipIfNeeded(id, playback=true)` inside a rip-ahead window gate — the AM→burned dead-air fix.
- **Burn a collection:** `BurnStore.burn(songs)` → `beginRun()` → per song: STOP check at loop top → fresh-skip (`isFresh`: size == bytes && rippedAt ≤ downloadedAt) → not-in-manifest ⇒ error item `notRipped` (never blocks on a rip) → presign (6 h TTL, one retry) → pre-render sidecar + filenames on the caller's thread → persist `.downloading` BurnItem + TransferRecord BEFORE enqueue → `TransferCoordinator.enqueue` → worker downloads, rejects non-2xx bodies (never finalizes an XML error as audio), analog shared file don't-clobber, writes sidecar, `finalizeBurn` upserts `.ready` + `onAnyBurnFinalized`. Post-pass: stems + beat-grid pulls (idempotent, best-effort, STOP-aware). `pendingAfterRip` drains on `onRipReady` and at launch; an intent is cleared only when `burned > 0`.
- **Prune:** `StoragePruneWorker` (periodic 24 h, constraints: idle not required) and `onResume` → `StorageManager.pruneIfDue()` → cap active && last stamp ≥ 20 h → **stamp first** → `sweepOrphanAuxFiles()` if over cap → order = ready items minus protected, by `PlayStatsStore.lastPlayedAt(SongVariant.baseId)` asc then `downloadedAt` asc → `EvictionPlanner.plan(order, capBytes, capSongs)` (ONE listing per root; shared analog audio freed with its LAST referencing item; aux files credited from every root) → evict in chunks of 25 with `yield()` and a per-chunk re-read of `protectedSongIds` → re-measure once → `PruneResult`.
- **Sync pass:** `syncAtLaunch` (awaited by the launch pipeline after onboarding, 8 s deadline) → `fetchMeta(all keys)` → per entry: cloud newer by >2 s ⇒ backup `.pre-cloud`, write (or `applyPayload` seam), watermark pulled mtime, `reload()`, if the file mtime moved during reload ⇒ clear the watermark (merged superset must publish) ; local newer ⇒ push if `pushAllowed()`. `syncOnForeground` (5 min), `syncTick` (20 s while active), `pushOnBackground` → `pushDirty` with meta probe (absent ⇒ push; strictly newer cloud ⇒ skip).
- **Diag:** `DiagLog.log(category, msg)` (never secrets) → in-memory part buffer → flush rules → `UploadQueue` (serial, newest body per key) → `SigV4.put(host=diagLogsBase, key, body)` → `UploadStatus` persisted (DataStore keys `pdj.diag.lastSuccessAt/lastError/lastErrorAt`). Keyless ⇒ bounded buffer (499 lines + marker), uploaded when a key arrives (Settings entry, `.pdjdiagkey` import, or `diag-key` sync doc).

All JSON through `PdjJson.lenient` (unknown keys ignored, nulls → defaults); writes are `.part` + `Files.move(ATOMIC_MOVE)` like `CatalogService`.

### 4. Threading model
- Stores are plain classes (no `@MainActor`); each owns a `Mutex` (or a `Dispatchers.IO.limitedParallelism(1)` writer) and publishes `StateFlow`s. File IO never on Main; `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)` for disk, `Dispatchers.Default` for planning/merging.
- Workers (`CoroutineWorker`) must read NOTHING from live stores: destination dir, sidecar text, filenames, manifest key all ride on the persisted `TransferRecord` (ARCHITECTURE-APPLE item 18). Finalization hops to `BurnStore` through a process-wide `TransferCoordinator` singleton (AppGraph) exactly like `onBurnFinalized`; if the process was cold-started by WorkManager, `AppGraph.get(applicationContext)` lazily materializes `BurnStore` from disk.
- Progress: worker `setProgress` + an in-process throttled (0.5 s per task) `onBytes` flow; UI binds only the `StateFlow` mirror, never worker internals.
- `DiagLog` is single-writer on `Dispatchers.Default.limitedParallelism(1)`; `log()` is non-suspending (enqueue to a `Channel(UNLIMITED)`), uploads detached with `SupervisorJob`.
- Launch pipeline (MainActivity/AppGraph): `RemoteEndpoints.install` (sync, tiny) → `onboarding.waitUntilComplete()` → `cloudSync.syncAtLaunch()` → `catalogRepository.loadIfNeeded()`, `ripsRepository.loadAtLaunch()`, `burnStore.reconcileOnLaunch()`, `transfers.reconcileOnLaunch()`, `burnStore.drainPendingAfterRip()`, `storageManager.pruneIfDue()`; `ON_STOP` → `diag.flushOnBackground()`, `cloudSync.pushOnBackground()`, re-arm periodic workers.

### 5. Platform APIs
WorkManager 2.10 (`androidx.work:work-runtime-ktx`, new dependency) · `Notification.ProgressStyle` (API 36, guarded) · `androidx.security:security-crypto` EncryptedSharedPreferences · `javax.crypto.Mac` HmacSHA256 + `MessageDigest` SHA-256 for SigV4 · `ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument` for `.pdjdiagkey` import (MIME `application/json`) · zxing-core (already present) for the link QR · `StrictMode`/`Choreographer` for the jank watchdog · `android.text.format.Formatter.formatFileSize` for sizes.

### 6. Emulator vs device
Everything in this area is emulator-verifiable (headless AVD `pocketdj`, API 36) including WorkManager survival (`adb shell am force-stop com.levi.pocketdj` mid-download, relaunch, assert `.ready`) and the SigV4 PUT (needs a real diag key in the emulator's Settings ▸ Debug; otherwise verified by unit test vectors). Device-only: onboarding stage 2 real Apple Music sign-in (specs/applemusic.md fact 0.8), SAF folder picking on removable media, and Doze-constrained periodic worker timing (emulator: `adb shell cmd jobscheduler run -f com.levi.pocketdj <jobId>`).
decisions: Profile/document sync on Android = verbatim port of iOS CloudSyncService over a `CloudDocDatabase` interface, backed by S3 through a new first-party Lambda `pocketdj-profile-sync` (new OPTIONAL remote-endpoint key `profileSyncBase`; absent ⇒ sync disabled). Identity = profileId (durable UUID) + per-profile secret minted at enroll (X-PocketDJ-Enroll capability token like the rec engine), stored in EncryptedSharedPreferences; devices are linked by QR/code, replacing 'Link with iCloud'.

Background transfers use WorkManager (unique CoroutineWorker per songId, foreground progress notification; ProgressStyle on API 36) with the iOS `pocketdj-transfers.json` record doc (+additive workId). DownloadManager rejected (cannot write app-private filesDir).

Burns live app-private in filesDir/burns/ in v1 with the iOS ledger shape and byte-identical file naming; a SAF user-browsable folder is a P2 package and must capture the destination onto the transfer record at enqueue time (never read live settings in the worker).
Secrets (rip token, jukebox token, Music-User-Token, profile secret, diag key) move to EncryptedSharedPreferences; DataStore keeps non-secret settings. Additive one-shot migration.
Diag upload channel gate = BuildConfig.DEBUG || BuildConfig.DIAG_CHANNEL (internal flavour flag); release builds never upload.
Compiled-in endpoint defaults flip to the green account and are pinned by a JVM test to config/endpoints.green.json (blue account deleted 2026-10-15).
Android keeps 'no auto-/rip on Apple Music playback'; the passive stream-through rip is ported only for rip-server-streamed rows and setlist rip-ahead (inside a window gate).
PlayStatsStore is ported as a separate aggregate doc (not derived from the capped play-history log) because it is the prune's ordering signal and is a synced doc.
Mix DSP engine (Media3 vs Oboe) is not touched by this area; burn/stem/beat-grid file naming is the only contract fixed here.
Owner gate (iCloud userRecordID hash) is N/A on Android; favorites two-way sync (streaming area) must use a profile-id allowlist if it needs an owner concept.

Interactive ▶ rip wait is bounded to 20 s and returns a distinct StillRipping outcome; background pollToReady continues (2 s, ≤1 h, never terminates on phase=error) and fires onRipReady — replacing Android's current 30-minute foreground await.
